name: Consortia & Tender Marketing Scheme
benefit: - **Market Access:** Facilitates participation in government and PSU tenders.  - **Consortium Formation:** Enables small units to combine capacities and secure bulk orders.  - **Financial Support:** Assistance in EMD and security deposits.  - **Order Distribution:** Ensures fair allocation of orders among consortium members.  - **Credit Facilitation:** Helps in accessing finance for order executio
_eligibility_text:
- Micro & Small Enterprises registered with NSIC under its Single Point Registration Scheme (SPRS).

Or,

- Micro & Small Enterprises who apply to get themselves registered with NSIC under the SPRS along with all required documents in terms of the scheme.
- Their factory/unit should be inspected before filing of tender in terms of the Tender Marketing Scheme.
